title: Fragment Agitation
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji stepped into the ruins, the secret agent in the imperial capital thousands of miles away suddenly opened his eyes—the wretch who should have died had his fate reappearing in the Heavenly Secrets.

text.content: At the third watch of midnight, in the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds. The cold wind carried the scent of decaying leaves through the broken windows of the Servants' Quarters. Chen Ji curled up on his straw bed, his face pale as paper. A burning sensation radiated from his chest, as if something was awakening, struggling, and yearning to break free within him. The heat spread along his meridians, each pulse feeling like thin needles piercing deep into his marrow. Chen Ji bit down hard on his tongue, forcing himself to stay awake—this sensation was all too familiar to him, the sign of the Tianji Record Fragment resonating.

dialogue.content: "The time has come." A hollow voice emerged from Chen Ji's chest, the distinctive hoarse tone of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. "The seal on Chen Xuan's ruins is weakening. If you want the fifth page, tonight is your only window." Before the words finished, the burning in Chen Ji's chest intensified sharply, and a faint golden light seeped through his coarse cloth robe, glaring in the darkness.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly loosened his robe, lowering his gaze to the birthmark on his chest that had accompanied him for seven years—now the incomplete runes were twisting and reorganizing at a speed visible to the naked eye, resembling a trapped beast yearning to break free from its cage. The fifth page, he thought. After seven years, he had finally awaited the fifth page. The Tianji Record contained nine pages in total; each additional page revealed would enhance his foresight ability, but simultaneously, the Heavenly Dao's scrutiny would lock onto him with greater precision. For seven years, he had carefully played the role of atrash, weaving an impenetrable chess game with every "failure"—and now, the gears of fate seemed to no longer offer him the option of restraint.

"The coordinates lie deep within Kunlun, at the place where Chen Xuan fell." Mo Xiansheng's phantom slowly emerged from the birthmark—a withered old man's silhouette surrounded by faint black energy. "But I must warn you—the fifth page's manifestation requires dual activation through blood resonance and full moon power. Once you activate it, Heavenly Dao scouts for a thousand miles will sense the fluctuation." Complex light flickered in Mo Xiansheng's eyes. "Your death-feigning trick may no longer remain hidden."

choice.prompt: With the temptation of the Tianji Record's fifth page and the risk of exposure both laid before him, Chen Ji must make a choice—risk it all for a gamble, or seek another path?

choices.description: Immediately depart for Chen Xuan's ruins, forcefully activating the fifth page during tonight's full moon. The risk is extremely high, but the gains will be decisive.
choices.visible_cost: Identity exposed, Heavenly Fate Value consumed 50 points
choices.visible_reward: The Tianji Record's fifth page manifests, foresight ability greatly enhanced
choices.risk_hint: Imperial secret agents will lock onto your position, and unrest will arise within the Tianqing Sect

text.content: A glint of determination flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. He draped on his patched robe, brushed lightly over the birthmark on his chest with his fingertips, and the golden light immediately retreated. "Master Mo," his voice low and calm, "I've noted this. Seven years of waiting— what's one more night? But since exposure is inevitable, let them witness what a true trump card looks like." He pushed open the dilapidated wooden door; the cold night wind rushed to meet him. Toward the Kunlun mountains, dark clouds were dispersing, and a blood moon was slowly rising.

choices.description: Suppress the inner impulse, wait for a better opportunity. Use other methods to delay the Tianji Record's resonance, avoiding premature exposure.
choices.visible_cost: Fifth page manifestation delayed, may miss the optimal timing
choices.visible_reward: Identity remains hidden, gaining more time for strategic layout
choices.risk_hint: The ruins' seal may permanently close, conditions for the fifth page's manifestation becoming increasingly stringent

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the restlessness in his chest. "No rush." He murmured to himself, his nails digging deeply into his palm. "Seven years already waited, what's a few more days?" Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment, the phantom slowly fading, leaving only a sigh: "Are you certain? This is the only window in seventy years..." Chen Ji offered no reply. He closed his eyes, his mind racing through countless alternative plans. However tempting the Tianji Record, it was no match for the chess game he had painstakingly constructed.

choices.description: Attempt to trigger the fifth page's manifestation through other bloodlines or mediums, dispersing risk and avoiding personal exposure.
choices.visible_cost: Requires cooperation from others, exposing intentions to third parties
choices.visible_reward: May find a safer path for manifestation
choices.risk_hint: Blood resonance requires specific conditions, effectiveness of alternative approaches unknown

text.content: A sudden thought struck Chen Ji, a sharp gleam flickering in his eyes. "Master Mo, descendants of Chen Xuan's bloodline—besides me, who else?" Mo Xiansheng's phantom shuddered violently, clearly unprepared for this question. "You... are you certain you wish to pursue this path?" The old man's voice carried rare hesitation. "That child was taken by the Holy Sect many years ago. If you involve her..." Chen Ji remained silent, but his eyes spoke volumes. Chen Nian, his younger sister, taken by the Holy Sect as a "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" for years—perhaps she was the true key.

"Just at this moment, a soft footstep echoed outside the Servants' Quarters. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply as his body slipped like a ghost into the shadows beneath the bed. The door was gently pushed open, and three black figures filed in under the moonlight. The leader held a jade talisman emanating a ghostly blue glow—the infamous 'Fate Tracing Talisman' used exclusively by imperial secret agents. 'Strange, I clearly sensed a fluctuation just now...' The leader frowned as he swept his gaze across the decrepit room. 'Could it be an illusion?' Chen Ji held his breath, suppressing his aura to the extreme, yet his heart churned with waves of alarm: The imperial agents had arrived faster than he anticipated. The Fate Tracing Talisman could already pinpoint locations within Tianqing Sect—his 'waste' persona had likely been under surveillance for far longer than he knew."

dialogue.content: "Master Mo's voice rang low in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a hint of urgency: 'The Fate Tracing Talisman can sense fluctuations in Heavenly Fate. You consumed too much when suppressing the resonance just now—they're only confirming your position now, but the next time you use the Tianji Record, they can lock onto your location within three breaths.' Chen Ji silently hooked the corner of his mouth, a cold smile forming in his heart: These imperial lackeys had keen noses, unfortunately they would only ever track fluctuations in 'Heavenly Fate,' never knowing that the true danger was never the birthmark on his body, but his all-calculating mind."

text.content: "The three black figures searched to no avail. Just as they were about to leave, the leader suddenly stopped. His gaze fell upon Chen Ji's dilapidated bed. He crouched down and plucked a golden fiber thinner than hair from between the straw gaps, confusion flickering in his eyes. 'This is... residual Heavenly Fate energy?' He pocketed the fiber with his jade talisman and turned to his companions, murmuring, 'Report upward—an anomalous fluctuation detected in the servants' quarter of Tianqing Sect. A possible awakened Prophet.' Chen Ji, hidden in the shadows, clenched his fists so tightly his knuckles turned white. He committed the name to memory—this secret agent was called Zhou Li, a member of the imperial 'Tianji Pavilion,' specialized in tracking Heavenly Fate fluctuations. When this ordeal passed, he would repay it tenfold."

choice.prompt: "The imperial secret agents have already detected the anomaly and are preparing to report. Chen Ji must decide his next move—whether to stop them, let them leave, or have other plans."

choices.description: "Take the risk and permanently silence all three. Clean and decisive, but will completely expose your strength."
choices.visible_cost: "Completely expose your identity—there will be no place for you in Tianqing Sect"
choices.visible_reward: "Block the news and buy more time"
choices.risk_hint: "The three have considerable strength, and may have backup signal transmission methods"

text.content: "Chen Ji silently slipped out from under the bed, the hidden dagger in his sleeve gleaming coldly—the instant before he was about to act, Master Mo's voice poured down like icy water: 'Do not! Tianji Pavilion members have Life Talismans implanted within them. Upon death, related information transmits instantly to the imperial capital!' Chen Ji's movement halted, a flash of frustration crossing his eyes, then he nonchalantly retreated into the shadows. Very well, since killing them is not an option, let them carry the news back alive—in any case, he never relied on just one chess game."

choices.description: "Let them leave, but secretly leave a tracking mark to gather more intelligence."
choices.visible_cost: "Temporarily lose initiative; the enemy has time to set up their trap"
choices.visible_reward: "Gain access to Tianji Pavilion intelligence channels, advantageous for future countermeasures"

text.content: "Chen Ji watched the three depart, his fingertip secretly flicking out a particle of dust invisible to the naked eye, which attached to the leader's clothing hem. This was a contingency he had planted three years ago—a variant of the 'Soul-Devouring Gu,' colorless and odorless, undetectable unless one's cultivation exceeded the Core Formation stage. When they returned to the imperial capital, he could sense all their movements through the Gu insect. Master Mo seemed to sense something and sighed: 'You always treat everyone as chess pieces.' Chen Ji replied calmly: 'In this world, if you don't play the chess master, you become a chess piece.'"

choices.description: "Use the Tianji Record to fabricate a false 'Prophet' aura, directing them toward the wrong target."
choices.visible_reward: "Buy time for the true operation, mislead the enemy"
choices.risk_hint: "The illusion can only hold for two hours; evacuation required afterward"

text.content: "Chen Ji chuckled softly. The birthmark on his chest glowed golden again—this time he actively guided the light outward, but in a direction—the other side of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds. 'Let them chase a non-existent Prophet.' Master Mo suddenly understood: 'You want to muddy the waters?' Chen Ji straightened his clothes and silently slipped out through the back window. In the night, his figure vanished like a wisp of smoke. He chose no particular path—because he never played on a chessboard designed by others. Tonight, he was heading to a seventh backup contact point not even Master Mo knew about."

"Meanwhile, thousands of miles away in the depths of the Kunlun Mountains, at the entrance to Chen Xuan's ruins, a stone door sealed for a thousand years slowly opened. Countless cryptic inscriptions covered the door frame, and a jade disc embedded in the center suddenly glowed, resonating across an undetectable corner in the direction of Tianqing Sect. Deep within the ruins, a pair of withered hands emerged from a stone coffin—the second remnant will that Chen Xuan left behind upon his death, awaiting the arrival of a true blood descendant. And at that moment, in the secret chamber of the Tianji Pavilion headquarters in the imperial capital, an elderly man in black robes suddenly opened his eyes. The fate disc in his hand trembled violently. 'Interesting,' he murmured, 'Chen Xuan's inheritor has finally made a move... Issue orders—Kunlun branch on full standby. I want this one alive.'"

"Chen Ji knew none of this. He was moving swiftly through the night, his destination clear—there existed ruins of an ancient teleportation array between Tianqing Sect and the Kunlun Mountains, a discovery he had stumbled upon three years ago. If he could repair it, even just one percent, it would be enough to reach Kunlun within half an hour. 'Are you certain about this?' Master Mo's phantom manifested beside him. 'That teleportation array—I saw it with my own eyes back then. The damage exceeds ninety percent. If you force it...' Chen Ji cut him off: 'It's better than being cornered here by imperial agents.' His footsteps suddenly halted. Thirty zhang ahead, a familiar aura waited silently. Under the moonlight, a woman in Inner Sect attire stood with hands clasped behind her back—Su Qingyao. 'Chen Ji,' her voice cold as glacial ice, 'where are you going, this late at night?'"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji didn't slow his pace, a perfectly calibrated expression of panic spreading across his face. 'S-Su... Senior Sister Su?' he stammered, his eyes darting everywhere, the very image of a coward caught in the act. 'I-I just couldn't sleep, so I came out for some fresh air...' Su Qingyao snorted coldly, her figure flashing to block his path. Bluish frost sword qi lingered around her fingertips. 'Fresh air? Tianqing Sect's sect formation imposes a curfew on servant disciples. How did a worthless servant bypass the层层restriction?' She pressed closer, her gaze sharp as a blade. 'And that aura on you—don't tell me you picked it up from some servants' quarters.' Chen Ji lowered his head, shoulders trembling slightly, while in his heart he rapidly calculated: Her cultivation had advanced again. The condensation of her sword intent was at least thirty percent stronger than three months ago. This woman's talent was indeed terrifying."

text.content: Su Qingyao's gaze swept back and forth over Chen Ji, her brow furrowing tighter with each pass. Just now, while cultivating in the Inner Sect, she had suddenly sensed a faint yet extremely familiar aura—the unique aura belonging to the mysterious figure she had encountered three years ago while collecting herbs in the Back Mountain. She had investigated countless times without a single clue, yet tonight, this aura had actually appeared on a Servant Disciple. Coincidence? Or... Her fingertips grew sharper with sword qi as she coldly declared: "Chen Ji, I'm giving you one chance—tell me everything you know. Otherwise—" She didn't finish, but the sword intent said it all.

choice.prompt: For the first time in three years, Su Qingyao was this close to the truth. Chen Ji had to make a choice—to continue pretending, reveal partially, or completely lay his cards on the table?

choices.description: Deny all knowledge with even cruder acting to lower her guard. The risk is that her intuition may have already locked onto you.
choices.visible_cost: May be exposed, Su Qingyao's trust will decrease
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the status quo, continue hiding your identity
choices.risk_hint: Her intuition is exceptionally sharp; continuous pretending may backfire

text.content: Chen Ji flopped to the ground with a thud, his entire body trembling like a sieve. "Senior Sister Su, spare my life! I'll talk, I'll talk!" Tears and snot streamed down his face as his voice shook so violently it was almost unintelligible. "I do have something I've been hiding... I'm... I'm not an ordinary servant. I'm... the illegitimate son of Elder Han from the Outer Court! He told me to hide my identity, said it was to protect me... I really don't know anything else!" A flash of disgust crossed Su Qingyao's eyes—that old lecher Elder Han was certainly capable of such behavior. She sheathed her sword qi and said coldly: "Get out of here. If I catch you leaving your quarters again, I'll consider it a deception." Chen Ji scrambled away on hands and feet until his figure vanished into the night. Only then did a meaningful smile appear on his face.

choices.description: Admit to part of the secret, using the excuse of being 'forced into a conflict between powerful figures' to gain sympathy and draw closer.
choices.visible_cost: The information revealed could become leverage against you
choices.visible_reward: Significantly increase trust, may gain her assistance
choices.risk_hint: Her desire to investigate may intensify, making it harder to control her later

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then slowly stood up. The panic on his face gradually faded, replaced by an unnatural calm. "Senior Sister Su," his voice was low, "some things are dangerous for you to know." Su Qingyao narrowed her eyes: "Are you threatening me?" Chen Ji shook his head: "I'm warning you. What you were investigating from that Back Mountain incident three years ago connects to a scheme beyond your imagination. I advise you—" He paused, "to stop investigating." Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply. He knew indeed! Sword qi erupted once more, but this time Chen Ji didn't dodge. He simply watched her quietly. "You can kill me, but the truth won't disappear because of it. And you... will forever lose the chance to know it."

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶发现陈机不简单

choices.description: Reveal the Tianji Record Fragment, exchange it for a temporary alliance using mutual benefit.
choices.visible_cost: Lose all pretense advantage, become a target for everyone
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's full support; her resources and connections can be leveraged
choices.risk_hint: Once she betrays you, there will be no going back

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled. That smile sent a chill down Su Qingyao's spine—this was clearly no worthless servant? This was a wolf in sheep's clothing! "Senior Sister Su, do you want to see the Tianji Record?" Chen Ji loosened his collar, revealing the birthmark on his chest that was emanating golden light. The runes twisted like living creatures. "This is what you were investigating three years ago—Chen Xuan's inheritance, the Tianji Record. I'm notrash, but the only prophet selected by the Heavenly Dao in a century at Tianqing Sect." Su Qingyao's hand gripping the sword trembled slightly—not from fear, but from shock. He... he had been hiding such a secret all along? Chen Ji looked at her, his gaze profound: "Now you have two choices—report me to the sect, or... help me with something."

choices.memory_label: 苏青瑶得知天机录真相

text.content: In the instant Su Qingyao fell into shock, the birthmark on Chen Ji's chest suddenly trembled violently. An unprecedented golden light shot into the sky—toward Kunlun, the jade wall at Chen Xuan's ruins had resonated with his Tianji Record! Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently rang in his mind: "Terrible! Your sister's bloodline has been activated in the ruins—the conditions for revealing the fifth page are all satisfied, but the resonance wave... the entire cultivation world can sense it!" Chen Ji's expression changed drastically. He sensed several powerful auras approaching rapidly from the direction of Tianqing Sect Main Peak. What chilled him even more was that the sky above the imperial capital suddenly cracked open with a golden seam. An eye凝聚 by Heavenly Dao's will slowly opened, its cold gaze locking directly onto him.

Su Qingyao also sensed that terrifying aura. Her hand unconsciously tightened on her long sword as her voice trembled: "That's... the Eye of Heavenly Dao?!" Chen Ji didn't answer. He was rapidly calculating—the appearance of the Eye of Heavenly Dao meant he had been locked onto by Heavenly Dao's will. Whatever he did next would be recorded, analyzed, and predicted. The only way out was to complete the revelation of the fifth page before it fully locked on! "Su Qingyao," he suddenly spoke, his voice unusually calm, "you asked me earlier why I kept this hidden. Now I'll tell you the answer—because from the very beginning, I've been playing chess against Heaven." He raised his head, staring directly at the golden giant eye slowly opening, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth. "And now, it's time for it to feel what it's like to be outcalculated."

Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. He grabbed Su Qingyao's wrist and pulled her toward him. "Come with me!" His voice brooked no argument. "You'll witness what happens next, but no matter what you see—do not interfere!" Su Qingyao was startled by his sudden action. She tried to break free but found his strength alarmingly great. This was clearly no worthless servant? The sound of people approaching through the air from Tianqing Sect grew closer. Chen Ji didn't hesitate. Golden light blazed from his chest as the Tianji Record Fragment surfaced beneath his skin, forming a membrane of light that enveloped both of them. The next instant, the two figures dissolved like being swallowed by a current, leaving only the golden giant eye that had just opened in the night sky and the astonished faces of the elders rushing over to investigate.

As light and shadow alternated, Chen Ji felt as though he was crossing a river composed of countless runes—the materialization of spatial laws. Su Qingyao gripped his arm tightly, her knuckles white, clearly doing her best to suppress her fear. After a moment, the two landed in a barren valley. Looking up, the majestic Kunluan mountain range loomed before them, and deep within the valley, an ancient stone gate emanated a faint blue glow—the entrance to Chen Xuan's ruins. "How... did we get here?" Su Qingyao looked around in disbelief. "This is the heart of Kunluan, at least two thousand miles from Tianqing Sect..." Chen Ji didn't answer. He was staring死死 at the jade wall that had already lit up above the stone gate, his heart pounding like war drums.

The inscriptions on the stone gate suddenly lit up, and an aged voice echoed through the valley: "Bloodline has arrived, the seal will open. The fifth page... has waited too long." Chen Ji's birthmark on his chest convulsed violently, as if trying to break through his skin. He walked slowly toward the stone gate, each step heavy as a mountain. Su Qingyao tried to follow but was pushed back by an invisible force. "Chen Ji! Are you insane?!" she anxiously shouted. "We don't know what dangers lie inside!" Chen Ji turned back and gave her a meaningful smile: "Senior Sister Su, I said earlier, no matter what you see, do not interfere." He paused, his voice suddenly dropping low. "Because what you're about to witness is the greatest secret of this world—and my true identity." As his words fell, the stone gate thundered open. A withered hand reached out from the darkness, precisely gripping Chen Ji's wrist.

Chen Ji did not resist, allowing the withered hand to pull him into the darkness. The stone door slowly closed behind him, leaving only a barely perceptible gap. Just then, in a secret chamber of the Tianji Pavilion thousands of miles away, the old man in black robes abruptly stood up, his life disc shattering into fragments. "No...impossible!" he exclaimed, "How does Chen Xuan's remnant consciousness still exist! That boy...what exactly is his background!" He swept his sleeve violently, and dozens of transmission talismans transformed into flowing light, flying in all directions. At the same moment, deep within the imperial palace of the capital, a languid voice rang out: "Interesting. Send the Shadow Guard to investigate. I am...quite intrigued by this 'successor of Chen Xuan.'" And at that moment, in a certain forbidden grounds of the Holy Sect, a young girl imprisoned by chains suddenly opened her eyes, a flash of golden light passing through her pupils—it was her brother connected by blood, calling out to her.

Inside the ruins, Chen Ji was led by the withered hand through layers of stone corridors, finally arriving before a massive altar. In the center of the altar stood a stone coffin, its lid already open, completely empty inside. And the owner of that withered hand—a phantom condensed from black energy—stood quietly beside the coffin. "You have arrived," the phantom spoke, its voice identical yet entirely different from Mo Xiansheng's, "I have waited a long time, successor of Chen Xuan." Chen Ji steadied his heart and calmly asked: "Are you...the true body of Mo Xiansheng?" The phantom shook its head: "No, I am the second remnant consciousness that separated when Chen Xuan perished. His true body dispersed over a thousand years ago." He raised his withered, emaciated finger, pointing at Chen Ji's chest, "The manifestation of the fifth page of the Tianji Record requires three things—your bloodline, the power of the full moon, and...the final fragment preserved here with me."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly emerged from Chen Ji's chest, carrying a tremor: "Old...Teacher? So you have always been..." The phantom turned toward Chen Ji's chest, and a complex expression appeared on his withered face: "Mo'er, you have done well. Guarding this child for seven years—you have worked hard." Chen Ji keenly caught the crucial information: Mo Xiansheng was actually a disciple of this phantom? Then didn't that mean this "Second Remnant Consciousness" was Chen Xuan's true master? The phantom seemed to see through his thoughts and said calmly: "I am Chen Xuan's guardian. You may call me...the Gravekeeper. The manifestation of the fifth page has begun—are you prepared to endure the backlash of the complete Tianji Record...and the gaze of the Heavenly Eye?"

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, feeling the agitation of the Tianji Record fragment in his chest. Once the fifth page manifested, he would gain more powerful foresight abilities, but at the same time, Heaven's lock on him would become even more precise—like lighting a lamp in an inescapable net, drawing the attention of all hunters. He thought of his sister Chen Nian, missing for many years, the girl the Holy Sect had taken as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key"; thought of the chess game he had painstakingly woven over seven years, each move careful and treaded as if walking on thin ice; thought of the imperial court's secret agents tracking him, Su Qingyao's suspicions, the undercurrents within the Tianqing Sect... All the schemes, all the忍耐, were for this moment. He opened his eyes, his gaze resolute: "I am prepared." The Gravekeeper's withered finger pointed at his chest, golden light flourishing—the fifth page of the Tianji Record begins to manifest!

Agonizing pain struck, as if thousands of needles were piercing his soul simultaneously. Chen Ji bit his tongue hard, forcing himself to remain conscious. Within the golden light, he saw fragmented images—one after another—those were fragments of the future, upcoming changes in Heaven's Mandate. Deep within the Holy Sect, Chen Nian's tightly closed eyes; in the imperial palace of the capital, the true face of that languid figure; beneath Tianqing Sect, old Sect Master Ling Yuan conducting a secret ritual; and...behind that golden eye, an existence beyond comprehension, coldly smiling. However, just as the images were about to become clear, a terrifying force descended abruptly, directly interrupting his foresight. The Heavenly Eye had pierced through space and was directly gazing upon this place!

Chen Ji groaned, blood seeping from all seven orifices, yet he still stared fixedly at that pillar of golden light—the Heavenly Eye was not only gazing at him but attempting to seize control of the Tianji Record. "No..." the Gravekeeper's phantom trembled violently, "It is forcibly intervening in the manifestation process! Chen Ji, you must make a choice immediately—abandon the fifth page, preserve your life; or..." Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, a trace of madness flashing in his eyes: "Or what?" The Gravekeeper was silent for a moment, his withered voice carrying a hint of resolve: "Or use your Heavenly Fate to forcibly suppress it, but the price is—your fate for this entire life will be locked by it."

Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile appearing especially savage beneath the blood. "Locked就 locked." His voice was low and resolute, "From the moment I obtained the Tianji Record, I never intended to evade Heaven's Mandate." The moment his words fell, the golden light in his chest surged violently, Heavenly Fate pouring out like a flood through opened floodgates—50 points, 100 points, 150 points... The Gravekeeper cried out in alarm: "You are burning your own lifespan! Stop immediately!" But Chen Ji was deaf to his words, his consciousness gradually blurring, but those eyes grew increasingly bright. The fifth page's runes slowly formed on his chest, perfectly merging with the previous four pages, emanating an aura足以撼动天地. And the Heavenly Eye's gaze...for that instant, actually produced a moment of hesitation.

Just as Chen Ji was about to collapse from exhaustion, a clear, cold female voice came from behind him: "Chen Ji! Catch!" A jade bottle radiating warm luster pierced through the air, accurately falling into his hand. Chen Ji下意识opened the stopper, a sweet, clear spiritual energy instantly flooding his limbs—a diluted "Nine-Turn Soul-Returning Dew," enough to instantly restore a hundred points of Heavenly Fate! He turned his head and saw Su Qingyao standing at the edge of the altar, drenched in sweat, her inner sect attire torn and ragged from thorns. "How...how did you get in here?" Chen Ji exclaimed in shock. Su Qingyao rolled her eyes impatiently: "You think this girl is what? Worthless?" She stepped into the altar's domain, sword energy sweeping across, slicing the black giant hand attempting to approach Chen Ji into two segments—that was the tendril of consciousness projected by the Heavenly Eye!

With the support of the Nine-Turn Soul-Returning Dew, Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate consumption finally ceased. The manifestation of the fifth page of the Tianji Record entered its final stage, the runes completely forming on his chest, the golden light illuminating the entire altar as bright as daylight. However, the Heavenly Eye had not given up, instead becoming more frantic in projecting tendrils of consciousness, attempting to seize control at the final moment. Su Qingyao's strength alone was difficult to sustain, her sword energy gradually being entangled by the black tendrils, clearly unable to hold on much longer. "Chen Ji!" she gritted her teeth and shouted, "Complete the manifestation quickly, I...I can't hold on much longer!" Chen Ji looked at that woman who had明明嘴上说着"不要插手"却还是冲进来救他的女人, a complex emotion swelling in his heart. Seven years, the first time he showed a genuine smile before someone. "Su Qingyao," his voice was gentle, "You are the first person I have fought side by side with in this world."

Golden light broke through the altar, soaring directly into the clouds. The manifestation of the fifth page of the Tianji Record was finally complete. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented power flowing through his body—his foresight duration had increased from three hours to a full day, and the clarity had greatly improved. However, the price was also severe; Heavenly Fate directly decreased by over 200 points, his lifespan shortened by at least twenty years. More importantly, from this moment, he would be permanently locked by the Heavenly Eye, no matter where he went, he could not escape that eye's gaze. The Gravekeeper's phantom slowly dissipated, leaving only a sigh: "The fifth page has manifested, the chess game of fate...has officially begun. Successor of Chen Xuan, go, go challenge the existence you think controls everything."

The altar collapsed, and the ruins began self-destructing. Chen Ji grabbed Su Qingyao's hand, and both ran urgently toward the exit. Behind them, massive stones constantly fell, dust and smoke filling the sky. "Where's your guardian?" Su Qingyao asked while running. Chen Ji shook his head: "He has dissipated. His mission is complete." The moment the two rushed through the stone door, the valley behind them completely collapsed, turning into ruins. Looking up, that golden eye still hung in the sky, but this time, it was not merely watching—it was...smiling. That cold, icy smile sent chills down Chen Ji's spine, as if to say: 'You think you are challenging me? Actually, every step you take is following my script.' Chen Ji clenched his fists, a cold smile curving his lips. Heaven's Mandate? Very well, let's see in the end who has outschemed whom.

At this moment, thousands of miles away in the capital, the imperial secret agent Zhou Li abruptly opened his eyes, the life talisman in his hand trembling violently. "Reporting to headquarters! Target location confirmed—Chen Xuan's ruins in the Kunlun Mountains!" His voice carried irrepressible excitement, "The fifth page of the Tianji Record just manifested! The target is traveling with a female inner sect disciple!" The transmission talisman transformed into flowing light flying toward the capital. Zhou Li gazed toward the Kunlun direction, a greedy gleam flickering in his eyes. Thattrash actually dared to show himself... This time, he would let the whole world know that the one who tracked down Chen Xuan's successor was himself, Zhou Li! However, what he did not know was that in a certain secluded corner of Tianqing Sect, an old man in blue robes set down his teacup, a meaningful smile appearing at the corner of his lips—that was Ling Yuan, the old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect. He murmured to himself: "Interesting... This game of chess is finally becoming lively."
